CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Mary Zendejas, 1st District  Megan Kerr, 5th District
Cindy Allen, 2nd District  Dr. Suely Saro, 6th District
Kristina Duggan, 3rd District  Roberto Uranga, Vice Mayor, 7th District
Daryl Supernaw, 4th District  Tunua Thrash-Ntuk, 8th District
  Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, 9th District
Thomas B. Modica, City Manager
Monique De La Garza, City Clerk  Rex Richardson, Mayor  Dawn McIntosh, City Attorney

  REVISED

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC
 The consent calendar shall be heard immediately after the pledge of allegiance, and prior to 6:30
 PM. All matters listed under the Consent Calendar are to be considered routine by the City Council
 and will all be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of said items unless the
 Mayor, City Councilmembers or the City Manager request specific items be discussed and/or
 removed from the Consent Calendar for separate action.

 CONSENT CALENDAR (1 – 17)

 1.  25-54872  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $1,500, offset by the Fourth Council District One-time
  District Priority Funds transferred from the Citywide Activities Department to
  provide a contribution to St. Joseph Catholic Church in support of their annual
  community fair; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $1,500, to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Daryl Supernaw, Councilman, Fourth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-54912  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $1,500, offset by the Third Council District One-Time
  District Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to
  provide contributions of:

  1. $250 to The Office of Special Events and Filming for the 2nd Annual Long
  Beach Mariachi Festival;
  2. $250 to the LGBTQ Center Long Beach for the 4th Annual Trans Day of
  Visibility Long Beach;

  Page 1 of 10
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD

  3. $500 to James Russell Lowell Elementary School PTA for the 2025 Lowell
  Carnival;
  4. $500 to Woodrow Wilson Classical High School for the Wilson High School
  Grad Nite; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $1,500, to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Kristina Duggan, Councilmember, Third District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-54853  Recommendation to refer to City Attorney damage claims received between March
  24, 2025 and March 31, 2025.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-54911  Recommendation to approve the destruction of records for the Police Department;
  and adopt resolution.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-54825  Recommendation to adopt resolution authorizing City Manager, or designee, to
  execute a contract, and any necessary documents, including any necessary
  subsequent amendments, with Community Partners, of Los Angeles, CA, as the
  fiscal agent for the Mayor’s Fund for Long Beach, to support an expansion of the
  Long Beach Early Learning Hub and Childcare Tuition Program, in a total contract
  amount not to exceed $250,000, for a period of two years, at the discretion of the
  City Manager. (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  City Manager

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-54829  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute a donation
  agreement with Care Closet LBC, Inc., of Long Beach, CA, for the donation of a
  2009 Ford F-150 half-ton pickup truck, formerly used by the Health and Human
  Services Department, with an estimated value of $6,500, to assist with cleanup
  and trash removal efforts at homeless encampment sites. (Citywide)

  Page 2 of 10
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Office or Department:  Financial Management

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-54826  Recommendation to adopt resolution authorizing City Manager, or designee, to
  execute a contract, and any necessary documents including any necessary
  subsequent amendments, with Medsearch Financial Inc., of Long Beach, CA, for
  continuing to provide as-needed, temporary, medical staffing, in a total annual
  amount not to exceed $350,000, for a period of one year, at the discretion of the
  City Manager. (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-54827  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all necessary
  documents and any subsequent amendments, including amendments to the award
  amounts or term, with the Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority, of Los
  Angeles, California, to accept and expend Crisis Housing grant funds, for the
  Family Crisis Housing Program, in a total amount not to exceed $210,000, for the
  operational period of January 1, 2025, through June 30, 2025, at the discretion of
  the City Manager; and

  Increase appropriations in the Health Fund Group in the Health and Human
  Services Department by $210,000, offset by grant revenue. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  25-54828  Recommendation to adopt resolution authorizing City Manager, or designee, to
  execute a contract, and any necessary documents including any necessary
  subsequent amendments, with Medicalistics, LLC, of Dallas, TX, for providing
  configuration, implementation and training to supplement and support the NextGen
  Electronic Health Record platform currently utilized by the Department of Health
  and Human Services, in an annual amount not to exceed $150,000, for a period of
  two years. (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Page 3 of 10
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 25-54833  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to amend Contract No. 36893 with JS MD Sigma PLLC, of
  Kempner, TX, for providing onsite cardiovascular biomarker detection, vascular
  imaging, and cardiopulmonary exercise testing to identify coronary disease and
  occupational stressors, to increase the contract amount by $200,000, for a revised
  contract amount not to exceed $400,000. (District 1)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 25-54830  Recommendation to receive and file the application of Soulfully Seafood
  Incorporated, dba Fishbone, for an original application of an Alcoholic Beverage
  Control (ABC) License, at 149 East 4th Street. (District 1)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 25-54831  Recommendation to receive and file the application of Dakin Alan Auret, dba Foot
  Work Records, for an original application of an Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC)
  License, at 400 East 3rd Street, and determine that the application serves the
  public convenience and necessity. (District 1)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

13. 25-54835  Recommendation to receive and file the application of Waffle Boys Incorporated
  dba & Waffles, for an original application of an Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC)
  License, at 95 Pine Avenue. (District 1)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

14. 25-54834  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to amend Contract No. 35693 with Vital Medical Services,
  LLC, of Glendale, CA, for providing jail inmate physician and relief nursing services
  at the Long Beach City Jail, to increase the annual contract amount by $62,000, for
  a revised total annual contract amount not to exceed $896,396, and extend the
  term of the contract to May 31, 2026. (District 2)

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

15. 25-54832  Recommendation to receive and file the application of Bard Associates, LLC., dba
  Hof’s Hut Restaurant for an Inter-County Transfer of an Alcoholic Beverage Control
  (ABC) License, at 2147 Bellflower Boulevard, submit a Public Notice of Protest to
  ABC; and direct City Manager to withdraw the protest if a Conditional Use Permit
  (CUP) is granted. (District 4)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Police Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

16. 25-54837  Recommendation to adopt resolution ordering the summary vacation of five (5)
  public streets segments within the Port-Related Industrial (IP) Zone District, four
  (4) are north/south street segments, located south of Ninth Street (9th) from Santa
  Fe Avenue to Harbor Avenue and West 12th Street South, bearing east/west and
  adopting findings related thereto. (District 7)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

17. 25-54836  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary for the Second Amendment to Agreement No. 31706 with
  the City of Seal Beach pursuant, to which the City of Long Beach provides
  maintenance, repair and collection services for ten parking pay stations by the City
  of Long Beach. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CEREMONIALS AND PRESENTATIONS

  Page 5 of 10
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH

  ARTS, CULTURE, AND CREATIVITY MONTH

  NATIONAL LIBRARY MONTH

PUBLIC COMMENT: OBTAIN SPEAKER CARD FROM THE CITY CLERK
Opportunity to address the City Council (on non-agenda items) is given to the first 10 persons who
submit Speaker Cards to the City Clerk beginning at 15 minutes prior to the commencement of the
meeting. Each speaker is allowed three minutes to make their comments.

REGULAR AGENDA

18. 25-54910  Recommendation to request City Manager to collaborate with Health & Human
  Services Department, Business Licensing, and other appropriate departments to
  develop a more streamlined and overarching event permitting process for
  established Business Improvement Districts (BIDs) and Business Improvement
  Associations (BIAs) and report back to the Council within 90 days.

  Office or Department:  Megan Kerr, Councilwoman, Fifth District; Kristina
  Duggan, Councilmember, Third District; Joni Ricks-
  Oddie, Councilmember, Ninth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

19. 25-54838  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to amend Contract No. 36266 with the Long Beach
  Nonprofit Partnership, Inc., of Long Beach, CA, for providing organizational and
  leadership development by engaging the City’s youth and emerging adults and
  youth-serving organizations, to increase the contract amount by $3,000,000, for a
  revised contract amount not to exceed $5,250,000. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Health and Human Services

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

20. 25-54839  Recommendation to adopt Specifications No. RFP HR-23-352 and award contracts
  to CPS HR Consulting, of Sacramento, CA, JL Group, LLC, of Laguna Niguel, CA,
  and Palicon Group, LLC, of Riverside, CA, for providing investigation services, in a
  total annual aggregate amount not to exceed $1,500,000, for a period of two years,
  with the option to renew for three additional one-year periods, at the discretion of
  the City Manager; and, authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any necessary

  Page 6 of 10
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  subsequent amendments. (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Human Resources; City Attorney

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

21. 25-54840  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute a contract,
  and all necessary amendments including term extensions, with the Department of
  Homeland Security to receive and expend grant funding for the 2024 Port Security
  Grant Program, in an amount of $840,001, with a Port of Long Beach cost match of
  $280,000, for a total amount not to exceed $1,120,001, for a period ending August
  31, 2027; and

  Increase appropriations in the General Grants Fund Group in the Fire Department
  by $420,001, and the Police Department by $700,000, offset by federal grant funds
  and Port of Long Beach cost match funds. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Police Department; Disaster Preparedness and
  Emergency Communications; Fire Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

22. 25-54841  Recommendation to adopt Resolution of Intention to establish Underground Utility
  District 42, for portions of Cherry Avenue;

  Set the date of May 6, 2025, for the public hearing on establishing Underground
  Utility District 42; and

  Direct City Clerk to mail notices of the public hearing, together with a district map
  and letter of information, to all concerned utilities and affected property owners as
  shown on the last equalized assessment roll. (Districts 8, 9)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

ORDINANCE

23. 25-54771  WITHDRAWN
  Recommendation to adopt ordinance amending the Long Beach Municipal Code
  by amending and restating Chapter 16.43 related to Airport Noise Compatibility,
  read and adopted as read. (Citywide)

  Page 7 of 10
   CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TUESDAY, APRIL 8, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Office or Department:  City Attorney

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT: IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO ADJOURNMENT
Opportunity is given to those members of the public who have not addressed the City Council on
non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes unless extended by the City Council.

STANDING COMMITTEE REMINDER

Tuesday, April 15, 2025 – Government Operations and Efficiency Committee (Attorney/Client) at
4:15 P.M., Beach Conference Rm.

Tuesday, April 15, 2025 – Government Operations and Efficiency Committee at 3:30 P.M., Civic
Chambers.

NOTE:

The City Council agenda and supporting documents are available on the Internet at
www.longbeach.gov. Agenda items may also be reviewed in the Office of the City Clerk or online at
the Main Library and at the Branch Libraries. Persons interested in obtaining an agenda via e-mail
should subscribe to the City of Long Beach LinkLB System at www.longbeach.gov/linklb.

of the City Council after the posting of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office

https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings.

If oral language interpretation for non-English speaking persons is desired or if a special
